problem: Every independent post-work review recorded in this repository targets documents, candidates, plans or coverage claims. No implementation module has ever received one, although the repository contains 115 Python modules, at least 13 of which are guard-role code whose failure appears as silent false acceptance. The one known defect of this class, the tampered-receipt acceptance in operation routing v2, passed the full TDD cycle and the whole test suite and was found only after the fact. The work review protocol now defines guard-role code and irreversible operations as high risk by default and prescribes reviewer-authored refutations beyond the executor's fixtures, but that prescription has not been applied retroactively to the accumulated unreviewed modules.
impact: a defect in a guard-role module presents itself as a pass, so the affected artifacts are accepted without any signal
